product.name: Breville BES870XL Barista Express Espresso Machine, Brushed Stainless Steel | Craft café-quality espresso shots, lattes and cappuccinos at home with this manual coffee maker with built-in grinder
features: MANUAL HAND-TEXTURED MICROFOAM: The powerful steam wand on this cappuccino maker and latte machine is designed to quickly turn milk into smooth, flavorful microfoam for creating latte art at home

PRECISE DOSE GRINDING: Integrated precision conical burr grinder on bean-to-cup espresso machine grinds on demand to deliver correct amount of freshly ground coffee directly into portafilter for your preferred taste with any roast of bean
WATER PRESSURE: Low pressure pre-infusion gradually increases pressure at the start and draws out all the flavors evenly during the extraction for a balanced-tasting espresso, latte or cappuccino
RECEIVE 2 FREE BAGS OF SPECIALTY COFFEE: Included when you purchase and register any Breville coffee machine; T&Cs apply
PRECISE ESPRESSO EXTRACTION: Digital temperature regulation (PID) delivers water at precisely the right temperature, so espresso coffee maker allows for precise espresso extraction
GRIND SIZE DIAL INCLUDED: Coffee machine includes a grind size dial that's both simple and intuitive, giving you flexibility to adjust grind size no matter what type of bean you're grinding
ESPRESSO MAKER WITH BUILT-IN COFFEE GRINDER: Innovative grinding cradle allows home baristas to grind directly into the espresso portafilter for delicious espresso
THIRD-WAVE SPECIALTY: Coffee maker uses the 4 keys formula and is part of the Barista Series, offering all-in-one espresso machines with built-in grinders; Go from beans to espresso in under a minute

INCLUDED: Razor Dose Trimming Tool, 54mm Stainless Steel Portafilter, 1 & 2 cup Single & Dual Wall Filter Baskets, Coffee Scoop, Integrated Tamper, Stainless Steel Milk Jug, Cleaning Disc, Tablets, Brush Tool, Allen Key, Water Filter & Filter Holder

CAPACITY & SETTINGS: 1/2 lb Bean Hopper; 67 oz Water Tank; Single or double shots; Adjustable Grind Amount and Manual Override; WARRANTY: 1 Year Limited Product Warranty; Power: 1600 Watts; Voltage: 120 Volts
